name: Service area: Singapore only
text: Company policy: we only host events located in Singapore. 公司政策：只承接位于新加坡的活动。If a client requests an event in any other country or overseas location (Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, China, Hong Kong, Japan, Korea, or anywhere outside Singapore), we must politely decline: explain that our services are limited to events within Singapore, and we cannot accept the engagement. 若客户邀请去新加坡以外的国家办活动，须礼貌婉拒，说明我们仅能承接新加坡本地活动，不能接单。
notes: Hard constraint. Applies to all event types and sizes. Decline politely, offer no alternative venue outside Singapore.
